This blog post by Ecosia outlines its strategy for integrating AI into its search platform while aligning with its core mission of 100% profit reinvestment into climate action. Ecosia emphasizes using energy-efficient AI models, partnering with renewable energy initiatives, and prioritizing user privacy. The post also introduces the concept of 'Climate Intelligence,' an AI feature designed to offer personalized climate advice and encourage sustainable choices.
